provenance_policy: Production frames must contain no reference-video screenshot, crop, extracted background, extracted logo, extracted presenter, or other reference pixels.
editability_policy: Every visible business element must have its own stable layer_id and an explicit content, asset, transform, style, motion, or lock contract.

elements.locked_reason: Current editor exposes only the title group, not master sublayers.
elements.replacement_action: Expose background fill, grid, frame, brand block, notice, and navigation as stable child layers backed by shared tokens.

elements.locked_reason: Brand text is nested inside the master and has no asset authorization slot.
elements.replacement_action: Create an authorized logo/text slot with independent visibility, transform, and replacement controls.

elements.locked_reason: Text content is hard-coded inside the master component.
